title: device.yaml
description: The manifest of a device of the person's own, format 1 of the device spec. The folder holding it is named by the device's slug.

format.description: The spec's format this manifest is written to.

kind.description: An effect in a chain, a MIDI track's instrument, or a MIDI effect among its midi_effects.

name.description: The title the panel and the browser show.

version.description: The device's own version, as text; the song records the one it was written with.

license.description: What others may do with the device, such as MIT.

run.description: offline: Python over the whole song, cached. realtime: WebAssembly on the audio thread. A MIDI effect runs offline.

entry.description: The code, a file in the folder: device.py offline and device.wasm in real time unless said.

source.description: A real-time device's source, Rust (.rs) or FAUST (.dsp), which daw plugin build compiles to its entry; FAUST makes an effect.

fields.description: The device's controls, in the order the real-time ABI hands them over.

min.description: Required of a numeric type; above 0 on a log scale.

max.description: Required of a numeric type; above min.

default.description: Required: a number within min and max, true or false for a switch, one of the choices for a choice.

scale.description: How the panel's bar and a lane move between min and max: linear unless said, log for hz.

lane.description: Whether a lane may move a numeric field; a MIDI effect's fields take none.

label.description: The name the panel shows, the field's name in words unless said.

unit.description: dB, Hz, %, ms or beats by its type unless said.
